people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Joab
people.line: Son of Zeruiah, commander of David's army

translations.web: In the morning, David wrote a letter to Joab, and sent it by the hand of Uriah.
translations.bsb: The next morning David wrote a letter to Joab and sent it with Uriah.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass in the morning, that David wrote a letter to Joab, and sent it by the hand of Uriah.
translations.asv: And it came to pass in the morning, that David wrote a letter to Joab, and sent it by the hand of Uriah.
